resources.string: Check that Wi-Fi or mobile data can access the Internet, then tap Retry.
Check your Internet connection, then tap Retry. If Tor still cannot connect, try another network.
The message relays did not answer. Wait a moment, then tap Retry.
This connection error does not erase your messages or contacts. Pending messages are not confirmed as delivered. You can turn Internet mode off and continue over Bluetooth with nearby contacts.
